I or T: › [ I or T ] to twist your body, or move part of your body, with small, quick movements
I + adv/prep: › [ I + adv/prep ] to move somewhere using short, quick twisting movements

NONE: › an act of wriggling
扭動；蠕動

example: A large worm wriggled in the freshly dug earth.
一條大蟲子在新翻過的地裡蠕動。
Baby Martha was wriggling her toes in the sand.
嬰兒瑪莎在沙子中扭動著腳趾。
The tunnel was low and dark, but she managed to wriggle through to the other side.
地道又低又暗，但她還是設法爬到了另一端。
After twisting and turning for a while, he managed to wriggle free.
一陣扭動之後，他設法掙脫了出來。
With a wriggle, she managed to crawl through the gap.
她身子一扭，設法爬過了縫隙。

NONE: › If someone wriggles off the hook, they avoid a responsibility.
逃避責任；逃避做…
› to avoid doing something that you do not want to do
逃脫，避開

example: He promised he'd help me paint the living room, but now he's trying to wriggle out of it.
他答應過會幫我粉刷客廳，但現在又想躲開。

NONE: wiggle room
› to hold something tightly with both hands and twist it by turning your hands in opposite directions
擰；絞
› also wring out to twist a cloth or piece of clothing with your hands to remove water from it
擰乾，絞乾（布或衣服）
› to kill a bird or other animal by twisting and breaking its neck
擰斷（鳥或其他動物的）脖子；掐死

example: She wrung out the shirt and hung it out to dry.
她擰乾襯衫並掛到外面晾乾。

NONE: › to force or persuade someone to give you something
強迫（某人）交出；說服（某人）給予

example: They managed to wring a few concessions from the bosses.
他們設法迫使這些大老闆作出了一些讓步。

NONE: › If you wring your hands, you show that you are worried or unhappy.
（因焦急或煩惱）絞扭雙手

example: Car dealers are wringing their hands over low sales this summer.
汽車銷售商正為今夏低迷的銷量而著急煩惱。

NONE: › a machine used for pressing water out of clothes by putting the clothes between two heavy, smooth, round bars
衣物絞乾機

C: C2 a small line in the skin caused by old age
› a small line or fold in cloth
› informal a problem, usually a small one

NONE: › If skin or material wrinkles, or if something wrinkles it, it gets small lines or folds in it.

皺眉（表示驚訝或疑惑）

皺起鼻子（表示不喜歡或不贊成）

眼晴周圍的細紋

抗皺霜
There are still a few wrinkles to iron out (= solve) before the agreement can be signed.
在協議簽訂之前還有一些小問題需要解決。
Sunbathing can prematurely age and wrinkle the skin.
日光浴會使皮膚提早老化、產生皺紋。
She wrinkled up her nose at the strange smell coming from the kitchen.
聞到廚房飄來的怪味，她皺起了鼻子。
Amy wrinkled her nose in disapproval.
艾咪皺起鼻子以示反對。

NONE: C2 (of skin) having small lines because of old age
長滿皺紋的
› UK also creased (of cloth) having small lines or folds in it
（布料有）褶皺的

example: a wrinkled face
滿是皺紋的臉

NONE: › an old person
老人
B2 the part of the body between the hand and the arm
手腕；腕關節

example: I sprained my wrist playing tennis.
我打網球時扭傷了手腕。

NONE: › a piece of material that goes around the wrist, for example to hold a watch
手腕帶（繞在手腕上的帶子，如手錶帶）
› a piece of material that people wear around their wrists to show that they support a particular organization or idea
帶在手腕上的帶子（用以表示人們支持某組織或觀念）
› a watch that is worn on the wrist
手錶，腕錶

U: › [ U ] formal the authority to rule or make laws

NONE: › past participle of
write

example: There have been at least seven writs issued against him for late payment of bills.

她已將起訴這家報紙誹謗的令狀送達。
holy writ
神聖的權威

NONE: › If one thing is another thing writ large, it is similar to it but larger or more obvious.
誇大了的；更明顯的

example: Hollywood is often said to be American society writ large.
好萊塢常被稱作美國社會的放大版。

I or T: A1 [ I or T ] to make marks that represent letters, words, or numbers on a surface, such as paper or a computer screen, using a pen, pencil, or keyboard, or to use this method to record thoughts, facts, or messages
A2 [ I or T ] to send a letter or message to someone, giving them information or expressing your thoughts or feelings

T: › [ T ] also write sth out to put all the information that is needed on a document
B1 [ T ] to create and record something, such as a book, poem, song, or computer program, on paper or on a computer
創作，寫作；編寫（電腦程式）
I: B1 [ I ] to have the job of creating books, stories, or articles that will be published
› [ I ] specialized computing to record information in the memory of a computer

+ that: › [ + that ] to say something in a book, newspaper, magazine, or document
（在書籍、報刊或文件中）指出，寫道

example: When you fill in the form, please write clearly/legibly in black ink.
填表時，請用黑色墨水書寫清楚。
[ + speech ] "I hope to see you next Saturday," she wrote.
「希望下週六能見到你，」她寫道。
Why not write (down) your ideas on a piece of paper before you start?
為甚麼不在開始前把你的想法寫在紙上呢？
[ + two objects ] I wrote my sister a letter.
我給姐姐寫了封信。
[ + to infinitive ] My mother wrote to give me details about the party.
母親寫信向我描述聚會的詳情。
[ + -ing verb ] The travel company has written giving information about the trip.
旅行社已發信提供了這次旅行的資料。
Please will you write (out) your name and address in full.
請寫出你完整的姓名和地址。
She writes children's books/poems.
她寫兒童書／詩。
Adam designed and wrote the software.
亞當設計並編寫了那個軟體。
He wrote music for films and TV shows.
他為電影和電視節目創作音樂。
The book is very well written.
這本書寫得很好。
She writes for a national newspaper.
她為一家全國性的報紙撰稿。
In the article, he writes that the problems in the refugee camps are getting worse.
他在文章中寫道，難民營問題正在惡化。
There was a problem writing to the disk in the A drive.
A 磁碟機在寫入時出了問題。

NONE: › to reply to someone's letter
回信

example: I'll write back and tell her we're coming.
我會給她回信，告訴她我們要來。

NONE: › to write a letter to a newspaper, television company, or other organization, to express an opinion or ask something
（向報社、電視公司等機構）寫信表態，寫信索取
› relating to a person whose name is not on a ballot paper (= a voting paper) but who wants to be elected
投票者在選票上所寫的非原定候選人的

example: [ + to infinitive ] People have written in to complain about the show.
人們紛紛來信投訴那場演出。
[ + -ing verb ] Thousands of people wrote in to the company asking for an information sheet.
成千上萬的人給公司寫信，索取資料。
They were running a last-minute write-in campaign.
他們正在進行競選前最後一場為非原定候選人造勢的活動。

NONE: › to write a letter to an organization asking them to send you something
寫信索取

example: Did you write off for a brochure?
你寫信索取手冊了嗎？

NONE: › to add someone's name to the official list for an election in order to show that you want to vote for them
（在選票上）寫上（非原定候選人）姓名

example: a write-in candidate/campaign
非原定候選人／由選舉人自填候選人的競選活動

NONE: › to change the story of a regular television or radio programme so that a particular character is not in it any more
去掉（電視或廣播系列劇中的）角色
› to report someone for not obeying a law or rule
記錄（某人的）違法（或違規）行為

example: The cop said he'd have to write me up for not stopping at the red light.
那位員警說，因為我衝紅燈，他只得給我開罰單。

NONE: C2 to decide that a particular person or thing will not be useful, important, or successful
認為…無用；認定…失敗
B1 to write something on a piece of paper so that you do not forget it
寫下；記下
› to show in a company's accounts (= financial records) that something is worth less than it was before
降低…的帳面價值

example: Did you write down Jo's phone number?
你把喬的電話號碼記下來了嗎？

NONE: › to add a particular detail or rule to a document
把…寫入（文件）

example: An agreement to produce five novels a year was written into her contract.
在她的合約裡加上了每年創作五部小說的協議。

NONE: › to accept that an amount of money has been lost or that a debt will not be paid
勾銷（債務）
› to be able to use the cost of something you have bought to reduce the amount of tax you owe
避免交…的稅
› UK to damage a vehicle so badly that it cannot be repaired
把（車輛）毀壞，使（車輛）報廢

example: The World Bank is being urged to write off debts from developing countries.
一些機構正促請世界銀行免除發展中國家的債務。

你也許可以把那輛車作為業務支出而避免交稅。

他的車在事故中完全報廢。

NONE: C1 to write something in a complete or final form using notes that you have made
（根據筆記）詳細寫出

example: Have you written up that report yet?
你把那篇報道整理成文了嗎？

C usually singular: › a period of time during which you fail to achieve anything
未取得任何成績的一段時間
› UK a vehicle that is too damaged to be worth repairing
損壞太嚴重不值得修理的車輛

example: Yesterday was a complete write-off as far as work is concerned.
就工作而言，昨天實在太失敗了。

NONE: › a report or article that makes a judgment about something, such as a play or film
（對戲劇、電影等的）報道，評論

example: The paper didn't give the show a very good write-up.
那家報紙並沒有對那次演出給予非常正面的評論。

NONE: B1 a person who writes books or articles to be published
作家；作者

example: a travel/sports/fiction/crime writer
遊記／體育專欄／小說／犯罪小說作家
She is a well-known writer of children's books.
她是一位知名的兒童文學作家。

NONE: › the condition of being unable to create a piece of written work because something in your mind prevents you from doing it
作者心理阻滯，寫不出東西
› a painful stiffness in the hand that people suffer from if they have been writing continuously for a long time
書寫痙攣
› to make large twisting movements with the body
扭動；蠕動
› informal to experience a very difficult or unpleasant situation or emotion, such as extreme embarrassment
痛苦不安，難堪

› the written works of a person, especially when they have been published as books

the writings of Karl Marx
卡爾·馬克思的著作

NONE: › a desk with drawers
書桌；寫字檯

信紙；信箋
› past participle of

B1 expressed in writing, or involving writing
